reviews.text:
I visited the clinic yesterday to get my neighbour’s cat vaccinated, and I had a really lovely experience. The reception staff were very welcoming, friendly, and helpful. The vet herself was absolutely lovely. As I am a qualified veterinarian in Algeria and would like to continue my veterinary career here, she kindly gave me some valuable information and advice about how to get started. I really appreciated her support and willingness to help me.

She clearly cares a lot about cats and their well-being. She is not only a wonderful vet but also a genuinely kind and caring person. I’m very grateful for her kindness and for making my visit such a positive experience. Highly recommended!

I have been using the cattery at the Animal Medical Centre for the past 3 years, and it has always been excellent.

My cat is quite noisy and anxious, but the staff have always taken great care of him and followed all the instructions I gave them regarding his care.

Even though I have friends who could look after my cat, I have always had much greater peace of mind leaving him at this cattery, especially because the veterinary clinic is on site.

A special mention to Shona and the rest of the team. I may not remember everyone’s names, but they have always treated my cat as if he were their own, and Im incredibly grateful for their kindness and dedication.

This is the best cattery for my little cat Sam ,l feel comfortable leaving him there he is safe and well looked after
With wonderful updates and messages which l so love
Big thankyou from me

Really happy with the service.
The Cattery took Really good care of my cat. Highly recommend the Animal Medical Centre Cattery if you are going away and want someone to look after your cat
Thank you for taking care of Loki and Maisie

Animal Medical Centre has always taken excellent care of my pets, with the staff showing real kindness and professionalism at every visit. I brought my cat in for a check-up, and everything was explained clearly, which made me feel reassured. The quality of care here makes it worth every visit.
Always professional and patient! Amazing vet

I went there for an emergency as the cat i was looking after had fleas. They were very patient with my numerous questions, they were extremely helpful and they provided me with a treatment solution that worked immediately.

Very good professionals

This clinic employs doctors you can trust, not those who see the wallet instead of your pet

Today I arrived for my appointment for my dog after phoning to book and being told there was a cancellation.  I haven’t been for over a year because AMC messed me around last year by cancelling my appointment a few hours before it was due to happen and when I phoned to rebook they tried to charge me for a cancellation which THEY cancelled.

Arrived today to give them a 2nd chance waited 25 minutes, whilst my dog became more and more anxious.  I thought I would buy him some healthy treats for sale on reception.  I paid over £20 for the treats which he didn’t like.  I ended up leaving the treats and the AMC after the very kind receptionist told me I would still have to wait further.  Rubbish booking system, overpriced treats.  No wonder the government want to legislate against greedy vets.

I have read your review and I am disappointed to hear that you have been misinformed.  I did not arrive late for my appointment and was NOT told I would have to wait ten minutes.  If that were the case I would have taken my dog for a little walk around the block.  I was definitely there longer than 12 minutes.

The vet was great, the receptionist needs to be replaced ASAP. 6m after the last consultation I requested refill for worm and flea treatments, she insisted to come for visit ( to charge me at least £100 for nothing ) just to weight again my yorkie who doesn’t change size 😅 whoever I text her again and I told her I just would like  to repeat medication she ignored what am asking for and start pressuring  me to asking what’s wrong with my dog, which isn’t her business at all. 😅😂 I have never received such an unprofessionalism from receptionist. Then I told her I’d like to look for another vet as I’ve been ignored she just texted me back. I successfully deactivated your profile with us, without even apologise to me and wished my dog all the best 😂😂😂😂🤣🤣🤣🤣🤣 PEOPLE please don’t bother  to WALK, just RUNNN as Fast as you Can…..!!!!
Great service. The receptionist and the vets were great and very friendly. Would 1000% recommend

Thank you animal medical centre for taking such good care of our dog during his castration. He is a nervous dog and you went out of your way to make sure he was as comfortable and calm as possible. We were even allowed to be with him as he woke up. The vet and the nurse were very kind and helpful.

I cannot thank the team at the clinic enough for the exceptional care they’ve provided to our cat. Not only did they help her recover, especially after the Christmas holiday, but they also supported us through an incredibly emotional time. …

I bring my cat into AMC and the staff are always welcoming and friendly. They offer a great service and provide great advice. I would highly recommend this practice whether it be for medical treatment or cattery stays :)

My kitten couldn’t pass poo since she was born and couldn’t be treated by few vets. Then we met Chris, an excellent and warm hearted vet from Animal Medical Centre. He did a successful surgery for this poor girl and gave her a new life now. …
